title: Python（pytest）
usage:
```sh
python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python3 -m pytest -q
```
dependabot:
- package-ecosystem: "pip"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "monthly"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 3
    labels: ["dependencies", "ci"]
    groups:
      minor-and-patch:
        patterns: ["*"]
        update-types: ["minor", "patch"]
